name_ja: アカガレイの子まぶり
name_en: Akagarei no Komaburi — flounder sashimi tossed with its own roe
summary_ja: 子持ちのアカガレイを刺身にし、ゆでてほぐした卵をまぶす岩美町網代周辺の一皿。フナの子まぶりが伝わって生まれたとされ、脂ののった冬の白身にコクのある卵が絡む、祭りや正月のごちそうという。
summary_en: Roe-bearing red flounder is sliced into sashimi and tossed with its own boiled, crumbled eggs, a dish from around the Amijiro area of Iwami Town. Said to have descended from a similar dish made with crucian carp roe, it pairs rich eggs with mild, fatty winter flounder for festivals and New Year's.
source_title: アカガレイの子まぶり 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Hatahata Zushi (Tottori) — vinegared sandfish stuffed with seasoned okara, no rice
summary_ja: 地元では「しろはた寿司」とも呼ばれる、鳥取市賀露地区のハタハタ料理。酢でしめたハタハタの腹に、いって味付けしたおからを詰め込む。ご飯を使わないためあっさりとして、賀露神社ホーエンヤ祭のごちそうとして振る舞われてきたという。
summary_en: Known locally as "shirohata zushi," this dish from Tottori City's Karo district cures sandfish in vinegar, then stuffs the belly with toasted, seasoned okara instead of rice. Being rice-free, it eats light, and it's been served as a feast dish at Karo Shrine's biennial Hoenya festival.
source_title: ハタハタ寿司 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mosaebi no Sashimi — a deep-sea shrimp found only in the Sea of Japan, eaten raw
summary_ja: 正式名クロザコエビ、鳥取で「もさえび」と呼ばれる深海のエビを刺身で味わう。鮮度が落ちやすく銅イオンを含むため半日で頭部が黒ずみ、遠方への流通が難しかったことから地元だけの味とされてきたという。
summary_en: Sold locally as "mosaebi" and formally known as the humpback shrimp, this deep-sea catch found only in the Sea of Japan is eaten raw. It spoils fast — copper in its blood turns the head black within half a day — so it long stayed a taste known only to locals, hard to ship any distance.
source_title: もさえびの刺身 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
